---
title: "Album Covers"
subtitle: "Exploring album artwork from Taylor Swift and Red Hot Chili Peppers"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

albums <- read_csv("albums.csv") |>
  filter(trackCount > 5) |>
  distinct(collectionName, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

This site showcases album covers and release information for **Taylor Swift** and **Red Hot Chili Peppers**, retrieved using the iTunes Search API.

## Taylor Swift

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

ts_albums <- albums |>
  filter(artistName == "Taylor Swift") |>
  slice_head(n = 8)

cat('<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 16px;">\n')
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ts_albums))) {
  cat(paste0(
    '<div style="border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; text-align: center;">',
    '<img src="', ts_albums$artworkUrl[i], '" style="width: 100%; border-radius: 4px;" alt="', htmltools::htmlEscape(ts_albums$collectionName[i]), '">',
    '<div style="font-weight: bold; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.9em;">', htmltools::htmlEscape(ts_albums$collectionName[i]), '</div>',
    '<div style="color: #666; font-size: 0.8em;">', ts_albums$releaseDate[i], '</div>',
    '</div>\n'
  ))
}
cat('</div>\n\n')
```
